say:3:1220238001:0.text: Oh my! Mister mage! I've been meaning to thank you for your help.
say:3:1220238001:0.source_cn: 哎呀！魔法师大人！您来了！还没感谢您的帮助呢！
say:3:1220238001:0.male: Oh my! Mister mage! I've been meaning to thank you for your help.
say:3:1220238001:0.female: Oh my! Miss mage! I've been meaning to thank you for your help.

say:4:1220238002:1.text: How was your date? We wanna hear all about it! Seeing your smile, I bet it went well, right?
say:4:1220238002:1.source_cn: 约会怎么样呀？\n不过看安格妮小姐的表情，应该很顺利吧？

say:5:1220238003:0.text: *Giggle* Fador said I looked beautiful and even asked about my perfume. It's all thanks to your magic!
say:5:1220238003:0.source_cn: 嘿嘿，法迪夸我特别漂亮，还问我用了什么香水。都是多亏了...

say:6:1220238004:1.text: What perfume? Little lady, you smell like fish!
say:6:1220238004:1.source_cn: 什么香水？你身上一股鱼腥味啊，人类小姑娘。

say:7:1220238005:1.text: Watch your manners, Hugin! You shouldn't talk to girls like that.
say:7:1220238005:1.source_cn: 喂，呼金，不可以对女孩子这样说话呀！

say:8:1220238006:1.text: Haha, it's alright. Rustport's water does have a persistent fishy odor.
say:8:1220238006:1.source_cn: 啊哈哈哈，没关系的，用锈锚港的水清洁就是会有顽固的鱼腥味……

say:9:1220238007:1.text: Even though you used cleaning magic this time, I'll still need to use the water I've saved for future dates... It's fine, I'm used to it.
say:9:1220238007:1.source_cn: 即使您这次帮我用了清洁魔法，以后的约会还是要用我努力攒...

say:10:1220238008:1.text: Well, our magister could also help with cleaning magic for future dates!
say:10:1220238008:1.source_cn: 咦，下次约会，主人也可以帮您用清洁魔法的呀，安格妮小姐。
say:10:1220238008:1.male: Well, our magister could also help with cleaning magic for future dates!
say:10:1220238008:1.female: Well, our magister could also help with cleaning magic for future dates!

But I couldn't trouble him every time. Your magic should be reserved for more urgent matters.

say:14:1220238011:1.source_cn: 小丫头，你等着，我看这附近有水阀，我这就让你看看，什么...
